mentions.name: Surmai
mentions.description: A personal and family travel organizer for planning trips together, with a focus on privacy and the ability to self-host; a managed hosted version is also offered for those who don't mind the developer having access to their data.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a Personal / Family travel organizer. Started as tool to allow me and SO to plan a trip together. There's been steady progress over the last couple years. Focus on privacy and ability to self-host. Of course, there is a managed version if one doesn't mind me having access to their data.
